usage: The word "書房" is used to refer to a room in the house dedicated to reading, studying, or working.
"書房" is a countable noun, so you can say "一間書房" to mean 'a study room'.
It often appears in sentences that describe place or function, e.g., '我喺書房做功課' (I do homework in the study room).
"書房" can be modified by adjectives or phrases like "細細的書房" (a small study room) or "新裝修嘅書房" (newly renovated study).
You can also use "書房" to indicate a designated work area at home, not just a separate room.
